find: const banked = sample.ticks < state.last ? state.total + state.last : state.total;
why: Issue #617. A `{ playUntil }` step counts only the CURRENT world's ticks, because the replay trace restarts at 0 on every new level and every retry after a lost life. A campaign-over capture then plays several worlds while claiming to be inside its budget, and the recorded cost under-reports what the capture actually spent.
killedBy: steps.mjs: advancePlay, the verdict of a played step sums ticks across a world rebuild, where the replay trace restarts at 0
steps.mjs: advancePlay, the verdict of a played step fails an over-budget run as "the game did not end", naming the selector, counted across worlds
